styles.name: Sunwashed
styles.description: Warm olive turf, broad chalky limestone, honeyed earth and pale fibrous bark. Restrained, low-contrast, sun-baked shapes.

styles.name: Wildwood
styles.description: Deep teal turf, violet slate, ochre earth and dusky plum bark. Angular clusters, crisp lit facets and deliberate dark cuts.

styles.name: Mineral Frontier
styles.description: Dry sage turf, rusty sedimentary shelves, umber earth and weathered bark. Long interrupted strata and low, graphic horizontal forms.
